title: 第14章 蛛网下的蝴蝶
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
密道里一片漆黑。

    玉玲珑走在前面，指尖悬着一团灵光，勉强照亮脚下几步远的距离。

    甬道深处弥漫着一层浓稠的灰白色雾气，贴着地面缓缓流动。

    “这雾不对劲。”

    玉玲珑停下脚步，灵光往前探了一尺，“有灵力反应。跟紧我。”

    林尘把手搭在碎星剑柄上。

    从擂台到密道入口，他只来得及把这把剑抽出来看了一眼——陨铁打造，剑身上布满细碎的银色纹路，但筑基期的灵力注入之后银纹只亮了不到三分之一就灭了。

    “碎星是玄阶上品，你现在催不动。”

    玉玲珑头也不回，“破境丹也先别吃，服用之后至少要静坐炼化两个时辰，现在没时间。都收好。”

    他把两样东西收回储物袋，跟着玉玲珑钻进了那道窄窄的石缝。

    甬道深处的雾气越来越浓。

    玉玲珑的灵光只能照到身前几步远，再往前就是一片浓稠的灰白。

    林尘刚想开口，眼角余光瞥见右侧雾里有什么东西在动——不是雾气翻涌，是一个实体的轮廓，正从石壁裂缝里往外挤，动作缓慢而安静，像一团烂泥从墙缝里淌出来。

    一只人面蛛从雾里弹了出来。

    八条覆盖着刚毛的蛛腿，每一条都有手臂粗细，前端是一个臃肿的腹部，腹部顶端嵌着一张人脸。

    五官扭曲变形，嘴角咧到了耳根，眼眶里没有眼珠，只有两团幽绿色的光。

    它从墙上直接弹射过来，两条前腿朝林尘面门刺下。

    林尘侧身避开，蛛腿擦着他肩膀扎进石壁，石板被刺出两个拳头大的窟窿。

    碎石还没落地，第二只已经从雾气中钻了出来，直扑玉玲珑身后——这一只比第一只更大一圈，腹部胀得像快要爆开的脓包，人脸上的嘴是张开的，露出里面一圈圈细密的倒齿。

    “背后！”

    玉玲珑回身一剑，寒月诀的灵力在剑尖炸开，一道淡蓝色的剑芒斩在蜘蛛前腿上。

    剑锋切入甲壳的瞬间发出一声刺耳的摩擦声，蜘蛛被震退了两步，但前腿上的剑痕很浅——金丹期的甲壳，元婴初期一剑只能留痕，不能斩断。

    第一只蜘蛛没有继续攻击林尘，迅速退入雾中。

    第二只也紧跟着后退，八条腿在石壁上爬行时发出细碎的咔哒声，声音从四面八方传来，分不清具体位置。

    “它们在试探。”

    林尘后背贴着石壁，握剑的手心全是汗。

    玉玲珑没有回答。

    她盯着雾气深处，灵光往前探了半尺。

    雾气翻涌了一下，露出一片石壁上密密麻麻的蛛网——不止一张，整个甬道深处都被蛛网覆盖了。

    网丝有手指粗细，在灵光下泛着黏腻的光泽。

    网中央挂着两团被蛛丝裹成茧状的物体，轮廓隐约是人形。

    一个已经破了，里面是空的，茧壳内侧还粘着几根发黑的骨头。

    另一个还完整，正往下滴着黏稠的液体，茧的表面微微起伏，像是里面的人还没死透。

    林尘低头看了一眼自己的手。

    从进甬道到现在不到半盏茶的工夫，手指已经开始发麻了。

    不是战斗的酸麻——是毒素从皮肤渗进经脉的感觉，像有无数根细针顺着血管往上爬。

    他试着运转灵力，流转速度明显比平时慢了一截。

    玉玲珑从袖中摸出两颗清心丹，自己吞了一颗，另一颗塞进林尘手里。

    “清心丹，能暂时压制毒性。但毒雾一直在，药效撑不了太久。”

    林尘吞下丹药，一股清凉从喉咙蔓延到胸腔，手指的麻木感稍退了几分。

    但只是稍退——毒素还在，像一条盘在经脉里的蛇，等着药效过了再咬回来。

    雾气再次翻涌。

    两只蜘蛛同时从不同方向冲了出来。

    一只扑向玉玲珑，前腿和腹部喷射的蛛丝交织成网封住她的正面。

    另一只从林尘左侧死角钻出，腹部末端喷出一束粗如手臂的蛛丝朝他腰上缠来。

    林尘翻身避开，蛛丝擦着衣角射在石壁上，发出滋滋的腐蚀声——丝上有毒。
content_en:
It was pitch black in the secret passage.

    Yu Linglong walked in front, with a ball of spiritual light hanging on her fingertips, barely illuminating the distance a few steps below her feet.

    A layer of thick gray-white mist filled the depths of the corridor, flowing slowly against the ground.

    "There's something wrong with this fog."

    Yu Linglong stopped, and Lingguang took a step forward, "There is a spiritual reaction. Follow me."

    Lin Chen put his hand on the hilt of Broken Star Sword.

    From the ring to the entrance of the secret passage, he only had time to take out the sword and take a look at it - it was made of meteorite iron, and the sword was covered with fine silver lines. However, after the spiritual power of the foundation-building stage was injected into it, the silver lines only shone less than a third and then disappeared.

    "Broken Star is a high-grade Xuan-level one. You can't push him now."

    Yu Linglong didn't look back, "Don't take the Breaking Realm Pill yet. After taking it, you have to sit quietly and refine it for at least two hours. We don't have time now. Put it all away."

    He put the two things back into his storage bag and followed Yu Linglong into the narrow stone crevice.

    The fog deep in the corridor is getting thicker and thicker.

    Yu Linglong's spiritual light could only shine a few steps in front of her, and beyond that there was a thick grayish white.

    Just as Lin Chen was about to speak, he caught a glimpse of something moving in the mist on the right out of the corner of his eye - it wasn't a surging mist, but an outline of a solid object, squeezing out from the cracks in the stone wall. The movement was slow and quiet, like a ball of mud dripping out of the cracks in the wall.

    A human-faced spider popped out of the fog.

    There are eight spider legs covered with bristles, each of which is as thick as an arm. At the front end is a bloated abdomen, with a human face embedded at the top of the abdomen.

    The facial features are distorted, the corners of the mouth are grinning to the base of the ears, and there are no eyeballs in the eye sockets, only two groups of faint green light.

    It bounced directly from the wall and thrust its two front legs towards Lin Chen's face.

    Lin Chen turned sideways to avoid it, and the spider's legs brushed against his shoulders and plunged into the stone wall. Two fist-sized holes were poked out of the stone slab.

    Before the gravel hit the ground, the second one had already emerged from the mist and pounced directly behind Yu Linglong - this one was larger than the first one, its abdomen was swollen like a pustule about to burst, and the mouth on the human face was open, revealing a circle of fine inverted teeth inside.

    "Behind!"

    Yu Linglong turned around and struck out with her sword. The spiritual power of Han Yue Jue exploded at the tip of the sword, and a light blue sword light struck the spider's front leg.

    The moment the sword edge cut into the carapace, there was a sharp friction sound, and the spider was knocked back two steps, but the sword marks on the front legs were very shallow - the carapace of the Golden Core stage, a sword in the early stage of Nascent Soul can only leave marks, but cannot cut it off.

    The first spider did not continue to attack Lin Chen and quickly retreated into the fog.

    The second one also retreated, its eight legs making tiny clicking sounds as it crawled on the stone wall. The sound came from all directions, and it was impossible to tell the specific location.

    "They're testing."

    Lin Chen's back was pressed against the stone wall, and the palms of his sword-holding hands were all sweaty.

    Yu Linglong didn't answer.

    She stared into the depths of the mist, and her spiritual light reached half a foot forward.

    The mist surged, revealing a dense cobweb on the stone wall - more than one, the entire depths of the corridor were covered by cobwebs.

    The mesh is as thick as a finger and glows with a sticky sheen under the aura's light.

    Hanging in the center of the net are two cocoon-like objects wrapped in spider silk, with vaguely human shapes in outline.

    One was broken and empty inside, with a few blackened bones still stuck to the inside of the cocoon.

    The other one was still intact, dripping viscous liquid, and the surface of the cocoon was slightly undulating, as if the person inside was not dead yet.

    Lin Chen lowered his head and glanced at his hands.

    It had been less than half a cup of tea since entering the corridor, and my fingers had already started to feel numb.

    It's not the soreness and numbness of fighting - it's the feeling of toxins seeping from the skin into the meridians, like countless thin needles climbing up the blood vessels.

    He tried to circulate his spiritual power, but the circulation speed was obviously slower than usual.

    Yu Linglong took out two Qingxin Pills from her sleeves, swallowed one herself, and stuffed the other one into Lin Chen's hand.

    "The Qingxin Pill can temporarily suppress the toxicity. But the poisonous mist is always there, and the effect of the medicine cannot last long."

    Lin Chen swallowed the pill, and a coolness spread from his throat to his chest, and the numbness in his fingers subsided a little.

    But it only subsided slightly - the toxin is still there, like a snake coiled in the meridians, waiting for the effect of the medicine to wear off before biting back.

    The fog rolled in again.

    Two spiders rushed out from different directions at the same time.

    One pounced on Yu Linglong, and the spider silk sprayed from its front legs and abdomen intertwined into a web to seal her front.

    Another one emerged from the blind spot on Lin Chen's left side, and a bunch of spider silk as thick as an arm spewed out from the end of its abdomen and wrapped around his waist.

    Lin Chen turned over to avoid it, and the spider silk rubbed the corner of his clothes and shot on the stone wall, making a rustling sound - the silk was poisonous.
title_en: Chapter 14 Butterfly under the spider web
